title: Meet The Artists August 18
paragraphs: Doris Mee demonstrating her technique of mixed media and collage ©Guild of Harwich Artists

Doris will create a mixed media/collage painting based on her popular, series, “Beach Cottages”. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand paints in watercolor or acrylic prior to assembling her collage. Several new paintings will be displayed.
Ellen will discuss and exhibit her latest works. Her medium of choice is acrylic that she uses to create colorful paintings of local landscapes and water scenes.

pwsbuilder August 6, 2018

Doris will create a mixed media/collage painting based on her popular, series, “Beach Cottages”. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand paints in watercolor or acrylic prior to assembling her collage. Several new paintings will be displayed.

Ellen will discuss and exhibit her latest works.  Her medium of choice is acrylic that she uses to create colorful paintings of local landscapes and water scenes.Source media unavailable.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
